g.text: UML Use Case Diagram : QAI-OLI Clinical Oncology Platform
Operational Actor Roles, 2-Column Symmetrical Grid & Traceability Matrix
SYSTEM BOUNDARY: QAI-OLI CLINICAL SUITE (WEB & INFERENCE ENGINE)
UML Use Case Specification Directory & Actor Traceability Matrix
Non-invasive smartphone/camera macroscopic RGB intake. [Actor: Community Screener]
Automated blur (Laplacian > 100), glare (<12%), hue coverage. [<<include>> from UC1]
Core 4-class diagnostic inference via ConvNeXt + DenseNet + 8Q VQC. [Actor: Clinician]
Evaluates 3 entangling layers in 256-D space. [<<include>> from UC3; Actor: PennyLane]
Convex soft-voting fusion (0.25, 0.25, 0.50) resolving Benign vs OPMD. [<<include>> from UC3]
Interactive exhibition of all 8 publication graphs & 25-paper benchmark. [Clinician]
Dual-stream spatial saliency heatmap with split-pane slider. [<<extend>> UC3; Clinician]
Real-time 8 Pauli-Z observables and polarization gauge. [<<extend>> UC6; Clinician]
Dynamic contextual justification text and rule-out criteria. [<<extend>> UC6; Oncologist]
Requisition document with unique ID TRI-XX-2026. [<<extend>> UC8; Oncologist]
Transmits structured JSON / FHIR records & DICOM overlays. [<<extend>> UC9; Hospital EHR]
